  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The --attr-source option is passed as a global git option rather than to the merge-tree subcommand.
  WHY: Git would reject it with exit 129, so the script would report merge_tree_unsupported and the local merge would never run. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 and glm-5_3-flash checked this and found it valid, because --attr-source is a top-level git option since git 2.40.

  WHY: The log output reports the wrong tested_base, which misleads operators. Other reviewers found the behaviour pre-existing and log-only, and did not report it.
